arrival.title: CMB → Colombo
arrival.label: ~1 hr
arrival.detail: Airport Expressway into the city; longer at rush hour.

transfer.title: Road trip · Colombo → Galle
transfer.label: ~2 hrs
transfer.detail: Straight down the Southern Expressway. Pick a stop or two above to take the coast road instead.

coast.title: Road trip · Colombo → Galle along the coast
coast.label: ~3.5–4 hrs driving + stops
coast.detail: The old Galle Road hugs the sea the whole way — slower than the expressway, but that's where the stops are.

departure.title: Road trip · Galle → CMB airport
departure.label: ~2.5 hrs
departure.detail: Southern + Outer Circular + Airport expressways. Leave ~4 hrs before your flight.

day.title: Stay in
day.tagline: Slow morning, pool, nap, no plans.
day.description: A day with zero agenda. Sleep in, take a long breakfast, read by the pool, nap in a hammock — maybe a massage or a wander to the nearest beach. Perfect between big days (or after last night).
highlights: Pool, hammock and a good book
Pick it as often as you like

night.title: Stay in
night.tagline: Dinner and hangs at the villa.
night.description: Sometimes the best night is the one where nobody has to go anywhere. Have the villa cook make a rice-and-curry spread (or order in), crack open the arrack, play cards by the pool and get a proper night's sleep.
highlights: Dinner at the villa — no travel
Pick it as often as you like

familyText.description: Sometimes the best night is the one where nobody has to go anywhere. Have the villa cook make a rice-and-curry spread (or order in), play cards by the pool and get a proper night's sleep.

transfer.title: Straight to Galle
transfer.tagline: Skip the stops — expressway, check in, pool.
transfer.description: Take the Southern Expressway and be at the villa in about two hours: early check-in, a swim, and a lazy afternoon before the first Galle evening.

specialDates.name: New Year's Eve
specialDates.intro: The big one. Your New Year's Eve pick stays pinned to 31 December, even if you reorder your days.
specialDates.departureNote: You'd be flying on New Year's Eve!
specialDates.calendarNote: 31 Dec has its own NYE picks

activities.title: Negombo lagoon & mangroves by boat
activities.tagline: Mangroves and fishermen, minutes from the airport.
activities.loved: Recent reviewers love the pelicans, monkeys and jumping fish — and guides who waited when flights were late.
activities.description: Glide through Negombo's lagoon and the old Dutch canal in a small boat, past fishermen casting nets, outrigger canoes and wading birds. It's right by the airport, so it works straight off the plane before the hour into Colombo.
highlights: Next to the airport — easy on landing day

sources.label: The Abroad Guide — Negombo lagoon boat tour reviews
Teardrop Hotels — canal & lagoon boat ride

activities.title: Colombo by tuk-tuk: markets, temples & street food
activities.tagline: The capital at full volume.
activities.loved: Reviewers love the street-level chaos of Pettah and a no-frills local lunch they'd never have found alone.
activities.description: Zip through Pettah's bazaars, past the candy-striped Red Mosque, Gangaramaya Temple and Beira Lake, then the colonial Fort and the Old Dutch Hospital. End at Galle Face Green with prawn fritters as the sun sets over the ocean.
highlights: Street food at Galle Face Green

activities.title: Colombo's Bawa & design trail
activities.tagline: Tropical modernism, gallery cafés and the city's best shops.
activities.loved: Design lovers call Number 11 the highlight of Colombo — and lunch in Bawa's old office feels like a secret.
activities.description: Geoffrey Bawa shaped how Sri Lanka looks. Tour Number 11, his own townhouse, then lunch at Paradise Road's The Gallery Café in his former office. Browse Barefoot's handloom shop and garden café, and finish at the restored Old Dutch Hospital.
activities.goodToKnow: Number 11 runs guided tours at set times — book ahead.

activities.title: Mount Lavinia: colonial hotel & beach day
activities.tagline: A 200-year-old governor's mansion on the sand.
activities.loved: A late-2025 guest called the pool 'really nice' — people go for the terrace, the cliff-top sunset and the beach shacks below.
activities.description: Half an hour south of the city, the Mount Lavinia Hotel started life as a British governor's residence in 1806. Spend the afternoon by its sea-view pool or on the public beach below, lunch at the seafood shacks, and stay for a cold Lion as the sun drops.
activities.goodToKnow: Pool access is usually a paid day pass or a lunch spend — we'd check on the day. Red flags mean no swimming.

familyText.description: Half an hour south of the city, the Mount Lavinia Hotel started life as a British governor's residence in 1806. Spend the afternoon by its sea-view pool or on the public beach below, lunch at the seafood shacks, and stay for a king coconut as the sun drops.

activities.title: Lotus Tower, Galle Face & One Galle Face
activities.tagline: South Asia's tallest tower, then the shiny new waterfront.
activities.loved: People go for the 350 m view at dusk, when the whole coastline lights up below.
activities.description: Ride up the Lotus Tower for the city and coastline laid out below, then wander Galle Face's promenade and One Galle Face — mall, food court and Playdium's games if you want an extra. Modern Colombo in one easy afternoon.
highlights: One Galle Face mall & food court
activities.goodToKnow: Foreigner tickets are US$20 (charged in rupees).

activities.title: Gangaramaya Temple, Seema Malaka & Beira Lake
activities.tagline: A gloriously cluttered temple and a Bawa pavilion on the lake.
activities.loved: Visitors love how eccentric Gangaramaya is — vintage cars, ivory, a museum of gifts — and the calm of Seema Malaka across the water.
activities.description: Gangaramaya is Colombo's most famous temple and its strangest: shrines, Buddha statues and a museum crammed with offerings from around the world. One ticket also covers Seema Malaka, the floating meditation pavilion Bawa designed on Beira Lake. Walk the lakeside afterwards.
highlights: Bawa's Seema Malaka on the lake
activities.goodToKnow: Entry is roughly LKR 300–500 for foreigners and covers both temples.

activities.title: Colombo club night
activities.tagline: Rooftop warm-up, then the city's dance floors.
activities.loved: Colombo has the island's biggest nights out — Latin nights at Margarita Blue and the house band at Rhythm & Blues get the most love.
activities.description: Pre-drinks with harbour views at Sky Lounge (The Kingsbury), then weekend DJ nights at H2O at Cinnamon Lakeside, Latin-flavoured Margarita Blue, or Rhythm & Blues with live bands. Fridays and Saturdays are busiest; dress smart-casual.
activities.goodToKnow: Entry is usually free–$15; smart-casual dress codes apply. Most places shut by midnight on weeknights.

activities.title: Sunset rooftop cocktails over Colombo
activities.tagline: Watch the skyline light up from the 14th floor.
activities.loved: ON14's infinity pool at golden hour is the shot everyone wants; Cloud Red's happy hour is the value pick.
activities.description: Colombo's rooftops are made for golden hour: ON14 at the OZO hotel has an infinity pool and 360° views, Cloud Red at Cinnamon Red does great happy hours, and the Kingsbury's Sky Lounge looks over the port.
highlights: ON14, Cloud Red or Sky Lounge

sources.label: The Rooftop Guide — Colombo rooftop bars (2026)

activities.title: Ministry of Crab feast
activities.tagline: Giant lagoon crabs in the old Dutch Hospital.
activities.loved: Still Colombo's most famous dinner — reviewers say the garlic-chilli crab is worth every rupee.
activities.description: Co-owned by two cricket legends and a fixture on Asia's 50 Best lists, Ministry of Crab serves huge Sri Lankan lagoon crabs garlic-chilli, pepper or curried, eaten with your hands in the 17th-century Old Dutch Hospital.
activities.goodToKnow: Book 2–3 weeks ahead for late December. Crab is priced by size — share big ones.

activities.title: Galle Face Green: sunset & street food
activities.tagline: Kites, crowds and prawn fritters by the sea.
activities.loved: It's where the whole city comes at dusk — cheap, chaotic and the most Colombo hour of the day.
activities.description: Colombo's seafront promenade at dusk: kites, cricket and families. Graze the stalls — isso vadai (prawn fritters), kottu, grilled corn, mango with chilli — then a drink on the old Galle Face Hotel's verandah as the lights come on.
highlights: Isso vadai, kottu & mango with chilli
G&T on the Galle Face Hotel verandah

activities.title: High-roller night: Colombo's casinos
activities.tagline: Dress up, chips on the table, go big.
activities.loved: Colombo is South Asia's casino capital — people love the free cars and food, and the glitz of the new City of Dreams floor.
activities.description: Go all in: start on the glitzy gaming floor at City of Dreams Sri Lanka (opened 2025), then the 24-hour classics Bally's and Bellagio. Blackjack, roulette and baccarat at proper tables, complimentary food for players, and a late cocktail if you're up.
highlights: City of Dreams — the new mega-resort
Free cars back to your hotel
activities.goodToKnow: Bring your passport — expect an ID check and a 21+ age limit. Smart-casual dress. The cost shown is food & drinks — set your own gambling budget.

activities.title: Pub Golf: tee off at Bellagio
activities.tagline: A flutter at the casino, then six bars, six pars.
activities.loved: Everything in Colombo 3 is a short tuk-tuk apart — perfect for a scorecard crawl that ends at the Galle Face Hotel.
activities.description: Sidemen-style Pub Golf, Colombo edition. Hole 0 is the tee-off at Bellagio Colombo on R. A. De Mel Mawatha: everyone puts one small bet on the roulette wheel. Then it's a crawl north through Colombo 3 — live music, a rooftop, a Latin bar — finishing on the Galle Face Hotel's lawn by the sea.
highlights: Finish at the Galle Face Hotel

sources.label: Time Out — Bellagio Casino (430 R A De Mel Mawatha, Colombo 3)

activities.goodToKnow: Bellagio is open 24 hours (passport, 21+). Colombo's bar scene changes fast — we'll confirm the holes nearer the time. Fri & Sat are liveliest.

rules.title: Pub Golf rules
items: Hole 0 · Tee-off: one bet each at Bellagio (max LKR 2,000). Double your chips = −1; lose them = +1.
Each bar is a hole. Par is the number of sips to finish your drink.
Count your sips; lowest total after the last hole wins the green jacket.
Hole in one (finish in one sip): −1 bonus.
Soft drinks & mocktails count — the score is sips, not units.
Water hazard: a glass of water at every hole, or take a +1.
Bunker: phone out at the bar = +1.
Dress code: golf caps, polos, plaid — commit to the bit.
Know your limit. Anyone can switch to softs and keep playing.

course.area: R. A. De Mel Mawatha, Colombo 3
course.note: Hole 0 · Tee-off: one small bet each

activities.title: Jet skis & water sports in Bentota
activities.tagline: Full throttle on Sri Lanka's water-sports river.
activities.loved: Calm river water makes it easy for first-timers — reviewers call a 15-minute jet ski the most fun $50 of the trip.
activities.description: Bentota's calm river mouth is the island's water-sports capital: jet skis, banana boats, tube rides and wakeboarding, with operators lined up along the bank. An hour and a half down the coast — a perfect first stop.
highlights: Jet ski, banana boat & tube rides

sources.label: The Abroad Guide — jet skiing in Bentota

activities.goodToKnow: A 15-min jet ski runs roughly LKR 10,000–16,500; multi-ride packages ~US$40–85. Calmest Nov–Apr.

activities.title: Bentota beach & a long seafood lunch
activities.tagline: Swim where the river meets the sea, then eat.
activities.loved: Travellers on the TripAdvisor forum call Bentota's sand the best stretch between Colombo and Galle for a swim stop.
activities.description: Pull off at Bentota's wide golden beach, where the Bentota Ganga meets the ocean. Swim, nap under a palm and order grilled fish and devilled prawns at a beach restaurant before rolling on to Galle.

sources.label: Wayro — Colombo to Galle drive: stops

activities.title: Bawa's gardens: Lunuganga & Brief Garden
activities.tagline: The two most beautiful gardens in Sri Lanka, by two brothers.
activities.loved: Visitors call Brief Garden 'a mystical garden straight out of a fairytale'; Lunuganga is a pilgrimage for anyone into design.
activities.description: Just inland from Bentota, architect Geoffrey Bawa spent 50 years sculpting Lunuganga, his country estate on a lake; his brother Bevis made Brief Garden nearby, full of statues and jungle rooms. Guided garden tours run a few times a day.
activities.goodToKnow: Lunuganga tours are US$20 for foreigners at 11:00, 14:00 and 15:00. Brief Garden is roughly US$10.

activities.title: Kosgoda sea turtle hatchery
activities.tagline: Rescued eggs, hatchlings and a lesson in turtles.
activities.loved: One of the oldest hatcheries on the coast (since 1981); people love seeing hatchlings and the rescued turtles being cared for.
activities.description: Kosgoda's hatcheries buy eggs from vulnerable nests, rebury them in protected sand and release the babies at night. A short, sweet stop with a guide explaining the five species that nest on this coast.

sources.label: HIDMC — visiting a turtle hatchery ethically

activities.goodToKnow: Several hatcheries line the road — we'd pick one that's government-approved and doesn't keep turtles in small tanks.

activities.title: Madu River mangrove boat safari
activities.tagline: Slow boats through mangrove tunnels and island temples.
activities.loved: A favourite stop on the drive south — people love the mangrove tunnels and the cinnamon-peeling island.
activities.description: At Balapitiya, small boats nose through the mangrove tunnels of the Madu Ganga, past the island temple of Kothduwa and a cinnamon island where a family shows you how the spice is peeled.

sources.label: Wayro — Colombo to Galle drive: stops
Expedia — Madu River boat safari listings

activities.title: Ambalangoda devil masks
activities.tagline: Watch carvers make the island's famous demon masks.
activities.loved: Reviewers love how enthusiastically the staff explain each mask's story — and entry is free.
activities.description: Ambalangoda is the home of Sri Lanka's carved masks, once used in healing rituals and dance-dramas. The Ariyapala mask museum has a small collection, a workshop where you can watch the carvers, and a shop if you want to take a demon home.

sources.label: Sri Lanka Tourism — the masks of Ambalangoda

activities.title: Snorkel with sea turtles in Hikkaduwa
activities.tagline: Wild green turtles cruising the shallows, right off the beach.
activities.loved: Travellers can't believe they're swimming with wild turtles in waist-deep water, 30 minutes from Galle.
activities.description: Hikkaduwa's coral sanctuary sits just offshore, and wild green turtles graze in the shallows by the beach most days. Snorkel straight from the sand or take a glass-bottom boat over the reef, then lunch on the strip.
highlights: Wild green turtles in the shallows

sources.label: Destinationless Travel — things to do in Hikkaduwa

activities.goodToKnow: Please don't feed or touch the turtles — people hand out seaweed for photos, but it harms them.

highlights: Wild green turtles in the shallows

activities.title: Peraliya tsunami memorial & museum
activities.tagline: A quiet stop where the 2004 tsunami hit hardest.
activities.loved: People call it a moving, important stop — the restored train carriages and the community museum stay with you.
activities.description: At Peraliya, just north of Hikkaduwa, the 2004 tsunami swept a packed train off the tracks. A tall Buddha statue donated by Japan stands where it happened, and the small Community Tsunami Museum next door tells the story through photos and survivors' accounts.

activities.title: Rumassala jungle trail & the Peace Pagoda
activities.tagline: A steep jungle headland, a white stupa and a hidden beach.
activities.loved: The 360° view over Unawatuna Bay and Galle Fort from the pagoda — and a swim at Jungle Beach to cool off.
activities.description: Climb the forested Rumassala headland from the west end of Unawatuna — steep, short and sweaty — to the Japanese Peace Pagoda, then drop down the rocky path to Jungle Beach for a swim. Legend says the hill is a chunk of the Himalayas Hanuman dropped on his way back from India.
activities.goodToKnow: Wear proper shoes for the rocky path and bring water — Jungle Beach has no real facilities. Cover up at the pagoda.

activities.title: Kottawa rainforest walk
activities.tagline: A pocket of real rainforest, half an hour from the beach.
activities.loved: An easy, shady first taste of rainforest — 180 tree species, endemic birds and a cool stream, without a long drive.
activities.description: Kottawa Conservation Forest is a small patch of wet lowland rainforest about 20 km inland from Galle, with an arboretum and walking tracks under huge dipterocarp trees. Go early with a guide for birds, monkeys and giant squirrels, then cool off in the stream.

sources.label: Tales of Ceylon — Kottawa Forest Reserve

activities.goodToKnow: Leeches after rain — long socks help. Wildlife is shy; it's more about the trees than the animals.

activities.title: Hiyare rainforest & reservoir trek
activities.tagline: Trek a rainforest that grew around a 100-year-old reservoir.
activities.loved: Guided walks end at the wildlife rescue centre — people love the langurs and how few tourists make it here.
activities.description: Hiyare is 600 acres of secondary lowland rainforest around the reservoir that once supplied Galle's water. A guide leads you along forest trails (no roads inside) to the water's edge, then to the small animal rescue centre run by the conservation team.

sources.label: Resplendent Ceylon — Hiyare trek & rescue centre
Sri Lanka Tailor-Made — Hiyare Reservoir Rainforest

activities.goodToKnow: December–April is the best window (less rain, clearer trails). Leech socks recommended.

activities.title: Kanneliya rainforest trek & waterfall swim
activities.tagline: A real jungle trek to a waterfall, with lunch by a lake.
activities.loved: Trekkers say the two-hour walk to Anagimale Falls feels properly wild — and the swim at the end is the reward.
activities.description: Kanneliya is a UNESCO biosphere reserve of tall, dripping rainforest about an hour and a quarter inland. A guide leads you through the forest to Anagimale waterfall for a swim, spotting lizards, monkeys and birds on the way, with a rice-and-curry lunch by a lake after.

sources.label: Sri Lanka In Style — Kanneliya trek with lunch

activities.goodToKnow: About 1.25–1.5 hrs each way. Guided treks from Galle run ~US$50–150 per person depending on group size — cheaper with our own van.

activities.title: Koggala Lake boat safari & Cinnamon Island
activities.tagline: Mangroves, island temples and cinnamon tea on a quiet lagoon.
activities.loved: Reviewers love how peaceful it is compared with the beaches — monkeys, monitor lizards and a polite, enthusiastic boatman.
activities.description: Koggala's big lagoon is dotted with islands: a temple island, Madol Doova from the famous novel, and Cinnamon Island, where a family shows you how cinnamon is peeled and serves you a cup of cinnamon tea. Glide through mangrove channels watching for kingfishers and crocodiles.

activities.title: Sunrise kayak through Koggala's mangroves
activities.tagline: Paddle out at first light to Cinnamon Island.
activities.loved: Small groups, glassy water and birds everywhere — people say sunrise is the magic hour.
activities.description: Paddle your own kayak across Koggala Lake at sunrise (or sunset), weaving through the mangroves to Cinnamon Island for a cup of tea. Beginner-friendly, with a licensed lake guide and all the gear.

sources.label: Airbnb — kayak through mangroves at Koggala Lake
Airbnb — kayak to Cinnamon Island at sunrise

activities.title: Cycle the paddy fields & lakes behind Galle
activities.tagline: Village lanes, rice paddies and a king coconut stop.
activities.loved: Reviewers say it's the best way to see village life — kids waving, buffalo in the paddies, and a guide who knows everyone.
activities.description: Guided bike rides start in Unawatuna and head inland on back lanes: the Paddy Trail (~12 km), or the longer Paddy & Lake loop to Koggala Lake (~26 km). Stop at the Eluvila bird sanctuary and for king coconuts under a village rest house.
highlights: Paddy Trail (~12 km) or Lake loop (~26 km)

sources.label: The Abroad Guide — countryside cycling review

activities.goodToKnow: Some lanes are uneven — fine for anyone who can ride a bike. Start early to beat the heat.

activities.title: Big day trip: elephant safari at Udawalawe
activities.tagline: Herds of wild elephants on open grassland. Almost guaranteed.
activities.loved: Of all Sri Lanka's parks, Udawalawe is the elephant one — people come back with dozens of sightings in a single drive.
activities.description: Udawalawe's open grassland and reservoir make it the most reliable place on the island to see wild elephants, often in big family herds, plus buffalo, crocodiles, eagles and peacocks. It's a long day: ~2.5 hrs each way, with a 3-hour jeep safari in the middle.
highlights: Big day trip · ~2.5 hrs each way
activities.goodToKnow: Park fee is ~US$25–30 per foreigner + vehicle fees; a jeep for six is ~US$60–80. Leave by 6 am to catch the morning drive.

activities.title: Big day trip: Sinharaja rainforest
activities.tagline: Sri Lanka's last great rainforest, a World Heritage Site.
activities.loved: Birders and hikers call it the wildest walk on the island — giant trees, endemic birds, blue magpies if you're lucky.
activities.description: Sinharaja is the island's last large primary rainforest and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. From the Deniyaya side, a local guide leads you along forest trails to waterfalls and viewpoints, looking for endemic birds, lizards and purple-faced langurs. A long, rewarding day.
highlights: Big day trip · ~2.5–3 hrs each way

sources.label: Civitatis — Sinharaja day trip from Galle
Expedia — Sinharaja trekking day tour from Galle
World Heritage Site — Sinharaja visitor notes

activities.goodToKnow: 6 am pickup from Galle; the last stretch of road is rough. Leech socks essential. Animals are shy — it's about the forest.

activities.title: Ella day trip · Little Adam's Peak
activities.tagline: An easy hill-country hike through tea to a sunrise over Ella Gap.
activities.loved: Hikers call it the best reward-for-effort walk on the island — tea pluckers on the way up, then the whole of Ella Gap opening out below, misty at sunrise.
activities.description: Little Adam's Peak (1,141 m) is Ella's easy classic: about 2 km from town, the last 30–45 minutes on a signposted path and steps through a tea estate, then a ridge-top view down Ella Gap to the plains. Ella is ~3.5–4 hrs inland from Galle, so it fills the day — add Nine Arches Bridge, the zipline or a waterfall while you're there.
highlights: Big day trip · ~3.5–4 hrs each way
activities.duration: Full day (~14–15 hrs door to door)

sources.label: Kate & Mike's Travels — Little Adam's Peak hike (2026)
The Portuguese Traveler — Little Adam's Peak complete guide (2026)
Take Your Backpack — Little Adam's Peak hike guide (2026)
Pickup Taxi Sri Lanka — Galle to Ella, ~200 km, 2026 van prices

activities.goodToKnow: Ella mornings are cool before sunrise — bring a light layer. It's an easy walk with steps near the top, busiest around 7–9am, and the summit has no shade at midday. Free; a tuk-tuk to the trailhead is a few hundred rupees.

variants.title: Sunrise at Little Adam's Peak
variants.summary: Leave Galle after midnight, hike up in the dark for sunrise over Ella Gap.

Walk up by torchlight (~45 min, easy)

Cool and dark on the way up (it's an easy path, though)

variants.title: Easy morning in Ella
variants.summary: Leave at 5am, hike mid-morning, then explore Ella.

Busier on the trail and at the bridge

A torch for the sunrise walk

activities.title: Big day trip: Mulkirigala rock temple climb
activities.tagline: 533 steps up a rock of cave temples and reclining Buddhas.
activities.loved: Visitors call it 'Sigiriya without the crowds' — painted caves, giant Buddhas and a summit view over the jungle.
activities.description: Inland from Dikwella, Mulkirigala is a 2,000-year-old rock monastery: seven terraces of cave temples with murals and three huge reclining Buddhas, reached by 533 steps (the last bit with an iron rail). Pair it with lunch and a swim at Hiriketiya on the way back.

sources.label: For 91 Days — the Mulkirigala Rock Temple
Sunday Observer — rock cave temple in the south

activities.goodToKnow: Cover knees & shoulders; shoes come off at the temples (socks help on hot rock).

activities.title: Blue whale watching off Mirissa
activities.tagline: Go looking for the biggest animal that has ever lived.
activities.loved: December–March is peak season — a blue whale's tail rising out of the ocean is the moment people talk about for years.
activities.description: Boats leave Mirissa harbour around 6:30 am for the edge of the continental shelf, where blue whales feed unusually close to shore. Spinner dolphins and sperm whales often join in. An early and sometimes choppy morning, but unforgettable.
activities.goodToKnow: Book 2–3 days ahead in December. Seasickness tablets the night before. We'd pick an operator that doesn't chase whales.

activities.title: Learn to surf in Weligama Bay
activities.tagline: Sri Lanka's friendliest beginner waves — you will stand up.
activities.loved: First-timers swear by Weligama: soft, sandy-bottomed waves and instructors who push you into every one.
activities.description: Weligama's wide, sandy bay rolls in soft, waist-high waves made for first-timers. A two-hour lesson with a local instructor gets most people standing; then smoothie bowls and hammocks in the surf town.

sources.label: Explore Hidden Sri Lanka — Weligama guide (2025)

activities.title: Scuba diving off Unawatuna
activities.tagline: Reefs, rock pinnacles and a century-old wreck.
activities.loved: Divers love the SS Rangoon wreck — upright on the sand and swarming with fish — and calm, clear December water.
activities.description: Unawatuna's dive schools run around 16 sites from 6 to 30 m: reefs, rock and wrecks. First-timers do a PADI Discover Scuba (skills in the shallows, then a guided reef dive); certified divers head to wrecks like the SS Rangoon at ~30 m.
highlights: PADI Discover Scuba — no licence needed

sources.label: PADI Travel — fun diving in Unawatuna

activities.goodToKnow: Fun dives from ~US$50; Discover Scuba ~US$90–110. Don't fly within 18–24 hrs of diving — not on Day 5.

activities.title: Dalawella: turtles, rock pools & the rope swing
activities.tagline: Snorkel with turtles off the sand, then the famous palm swing.
activities.loved: You can snorkel with turtles straight off the beach — no boat needed — and the palm swing is the Instagram shot.
activities.description: Just past Unawatuna, Dalawella and Wijaya beaches have reef lagoons where green turtles feed close to shore — go early at high tide with a mask. Then the famous palm-tree rope swing, Thalpe's carved rock pools and a lazy lunch at Wijaya.

sources.label: The World Trippers — things to do in Unawatuna
Travel Insighter — Unawatuna beaches for snorkelling

activities.goodToKnow: Mornings are calmer — waves pick up after lunch. Please don't touch or feed the turtles. Small fee for the swing.

activities.title: Unawatuna beach day
activities.tagline: A sheltered swimming bay, beach bars and hammocks.
activities.loved: One of the few south-coast bays calm enough to actually swim — people stay all day.
activities.description: Unawatuna is a horseshoe bay protected by a reef, so the water is calm enough to swim and snorkel. Loungers, grilled fish, cocktails and hammocks, with Galle Fort 15 minutes away for sunset.
activities.duration: Full day, at your own pace

sources.label: Sri Lanka Travel Life — Unawatuna Beach (Oct 2025)

familyText.tagline: A sheltered swimming bay, beach cafés and hammocks.
familyText.description: Unawatuna is a horseshoe bay protected by a reef, so the water is calm enough to swim and snorkel. Loungers, grilled fish, fresh juices and hammocks, with Galle Fort 15 minutes away for sunset.

activities.title: Mirissa beach-hop: Coconut Tree Hill to Secret Beach
activities.tagline: Palm-hill photos, hidden coves and a long lunch on the sand.
activities.loved: Coconut Tree Hill at golden hour is the shot — then Secret Beach's rock pools without the crowds.
activities.description: Start at Coconut Tree Hill — the red-earth headland of leaning palms — then tuk-tuk to Secret Beach's rock pools and climb Parrot Rock. Afternoon on loungers with king coconuts and seafood, and sunset as the bars warm up.
activities.duration: Full day, at your own pace

familyText.description: Start at Coconut Tree Hill — the red-earth headland of leaning palms — then tuk-tuk to Secret Beach's rock pools and climb Parrot Rock. Afternoon on loungers with king coconuts and seafood, and sunset by the waves.

activities.title: Hiriketiya: the coolest cove on the coast
activities.tagline: A horseshoe surf bay, great cafés and Asia's best bar.
activities.loved: People fall for Hiriketiya's tiny bay and creative crowd — and finishing with a cocktail at Smoke & Bitters.
activities.description: Hiriketiya is a tiny horseshoe bay with waves for every level, palm-shaded cafés and a creative crowd. Rent a board or just swim, eat well, and stay for a sunset drink at Smoke & Bitters — No. 14 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2025.
highlights: Swim or surf the horseshoe bay

sources.label: Wander with Jo — south-coast nightlife (updated Sep 2026)
Ada Derana — Smoke & Bitters in 2025 rankings

familyText.tagline: A horseshoe surf bay, palm-shaded cafés and a creative crowd.
familyText.loved: People fall for Hiriketiya's tiny bay and creative crowd — and the sunset from the headland.
familyText.description: Hiriketiya is a tiny horseshoe bay with waves for every level, palm-shaded cafés and a creative crowd. Rent a board or just swim, eat well, and stay for sunset over the bay.
highlights: Swim or surf the horseshoe bay

activities.title: Galle Fort: ramparts, boutiques & cafés
activities.tagline: Wander a 400-year-old walled town by the sea.
activities.loved: Walking the ramparts at golden hour as the lighthouse comes on is the moment everyone mentions.
activities.description: Inside Galle Fort's Dutch ramparts are lanes of colonial villas turned into cafés, design shops, gelato parlours and galleries. Walk the walls past the lighthouse, watch the Flag Rock jumpers, browse for linen and gems, and linger over lunch in a courtyard.

sources.label: Insight Guides — a walk around Galle Fort

activities.goodToKnow: Local guides (e.g. Galle Fort Walks, 4.9★ on Airbnb) run 2-hr walks — great as a first hour.

activities.title: Galle Fort street-food walk
activities.tagline: Egg roti, hoppers, wade and ten other things you can't pronounce.
activities.loved: Reviewers say the guides make it — 'like catching up with an old friend' who feeds you all afternoon.
activities.description: A local guide walks you through the fort and the market streets just outside it, tasting up to ten street foods: egg roti by the mosque, hoppers, isso wade, short eats, king coconut and wood-apple juice. A great way to learn what to order for the rest of the trip.

sources.label: byFood — Galle Fort street food walk
Lakpura — Galle Fort street food walk
Life.lk — insider's foodie guide to Galle Fort

activities.title: Village cooking class
activities.tagline: Market run, clay pots, ten curries — then you eat it all.
activities.loved: Consistently 5★ — people love cooking in a family kitchen and leaving with recipes they actually use.
activities.description: Small-group classes around Unawatuna and Talpe start with a market visit, then you grind spices and cook dhal, sambols and curries (one seafood) in clay pots over a wood fire — and eat everything you made for lunch.

sources.label: The Abroad Guide — Galle/Unawatuna cooking class

activities.title: Handunugoda tea estate & the stilt fishermen
activities.tagline: A coastal tea estate, then Sri Lanka's most famous photo.
activities.loved: The free tasting of 25+ teas (including the rare Virgin White) — and the stilt fishermen at golden hour.
activities.description: Handunugoda, near Ahangama, is the coast's tea estate: a free tour with tea and cake, the factory, and a tasting of 25-plus teas including Virgin White. On the way back, stop at Koggala for the stilt fishermen perched over the surf.

sources.label: Cover-More — tea tours incl. Handunugoda (free entry)

activities.goodToKnow: The stilt fishermen mostly pose for tips (LKR 500–1,000) these days — a photo moment, not a fishing trip.

activities.title: Koggala folk museum & Madol Doova
activities.tagline: Village life, old crafts and the island from Sri Lanka's favourite novel.
activities.loved: Rated 4.7 from 1,000+ reviews — people love the quiet seven-acre garden and the staff who bring the folk collection to life.
activities.description: The Martin Wickramasinghe Folk Museum is the childhood home of Sri Lanka's best-loved writer, with a collection of masks, puppets, tools and boats showing how village life worked. Afterwards, look out over Koggala Lake to Madol Doova, the island from his famous novel.
activities.goodToKnow: Foreigner entry ~LKR 1,000.

activities.title: Ahangama: yoga, cafés & a beach club
activities.tagline: The coast's coolest little town, at half speed.
activities.loved: Morning vinyasa at a jungle shala, a long brunch, then a beach-club afternoon — people call Ahangama the best-vibed stretch of the coast.
activities.description: Start with a drop-in yoga class (The Nuga House does 8:30 am daily, mats and pool included), then café-hop Ahangama's strip of brunch spots before an afternoon on a beach-club lounger watching the surfers at Kabalana.

sources.label: Girl on a Zebra — yoga in Ahangama (2025)
Wander with Jo — south-coast nightlife (updated Sep 2026)

familyText.title: Ahangama: yoga, cafés & a beach afternoon
familyText.loved: Morning vinyasa at a jungle shala, a long brunch, then a lazy afternoon on the sand — people call Ahangama the best-vibed stretch of the coast.
familyText.description: Start with a drop-in yoga class (The Nuga House does 8:30 am daily, mats and pool included), then café-hop Ahangama's strip of brunch spots before an afternoon on a beachfront lounger watching the surfers at Kabalana.

activities.title: Unawatuna beach party
activities.tagline: DJs, fire shows and dancing on the sand.
activities.loved: The closest proper beach party to Galle — barefoot dancing and fire dancers, 15 minutes from the villa.
activities.description: In peak season Unawatuna's bay throws weekend beach parties: Happy Banana's beach-club night on Fridays and Kingfisher's DJ night on Saturdays, with fire dancers on the sand and a mixed crowd of travellers and locals.
activities.goodToKnow: Poya (full-moon) days are dry island-wide — no alcohol sales, so parties move.

activities.title: Sunset on Galle Fort's ramparts & dinner
activities.tagline: Golden hour on the walls, then lantern-lit lanes.
activities.loved: Half of Galle comes out on the walls at sunset — kids' cricket, kites, couples — and the lanes glow after dark.
activities.description: Join the crowd on the fort walls as the sun drops into the ocean, then wander the lantern-lit lanes for dinner — rice-and-curry, wood-fired pizza or seafood platters — and a nightcap at a courtyard bar.

sources.label: Resplendent Ceylon — best restaurants & bars in Galle
Insight Guides — a walk around Galle Fort

familyText.description: Join the crowd on the fort walls as the sun drops into the ocean, then wander the lantern-lit lanes for dinner — rice-and-curry, wood-fired pizza or seafood platters — and dessert in a courtyard café.

activities.title: Arrack cocktails at Ropewalk & a rooftop
activities.tagline: Galle's best cocktail bar, then the city from above.
activities.loved: Ropewalk is the only Galle bar on Asia's 50 Best (extended list) — people go for the arrack tasting flights.
activities.description: Start inside the Galle Fort Hotel at Ropewalk, an arrack-focused cocktail bar ranked #93 on Asia's 50 Best Bars extended list — order a tasting or an arrack sour. Then up to Bommu, the Radisson Blu's rooftop, for live music as the sun goes down.

sources.label: Daily Mirror — Ropewalk on Asia's 50 Best Bars extended list
Radisson Blu Galle — Bommu rooftop bar

activities.title: Pub Golf: Galle Fort → Unawatuna
activities.tagline: Tee off inside the fort, finish on the beach.
activities.loved: Fort cocktails, then beach bars a 15-minute tuk-tuk away — the perfect scorecard route.
activities.description: Pub Golf, south-coast edition: arrack sours in the lantern-lit lanes of Galle Fort, then a 15-minute tuk-tuk to Unawatuna's beach bars for the back three, finishing on a dance floor. Count your sips, beat par, lowest score wins.
highlights: Best on a Friday or Saturday
activities.goodToKnow: Galle Fort winds down around 11 pm, so tee off early. Happy Banana's party night is Friday, Kingfisher's Saturday.

rules.title: Pub Golf rules
items: Each bar is a hole. Par is the number of sips to finish your drink.
Count your sips; lowest total after six holes wins the green jacket.
Hole in one (finish in one sip): −1 bonus.
Soft drinks & mocktails count — the score is sips, not units.
Water hazard: a glass of water at every hole, or take a +1.
Bunker: phone out at the bar = +1.
Dress code: golf caps, polos, plaid — commit to the bit.
Know your limit. Anyone can switch to softs and keep playing.

course.venue: Coats of Arms Bar, Jetwing Lighthouse

activities.title: Hikkaduwa beach party
activities.tagline: The original south-coast party strip.
activities.loved: Cheap drinks, cheap entry and a proper dance floor on the sand — Vibration is the classic.
activities.description: Hikkaduwa has been partying since the hippie-trail days. Vibration's beach venue runs Wednesday and Friday nights, and Mambo's is the weekend spot — reggae, EDM and baila on the sand, 30 minutes from Galle.

sources.label: Explore Hidden Sri Lanka — Hikkaduwa at night

activities.goodToKnow: Quieter than its heyday; one 2026 guide calls it a quieter season — we'd check what's on.

activities.title: The Doctor's House, Madiha
activities.tagline: The south coast's favourite party, in an old beach villa.
activities.loved: Wood-fired pizza at sunset, then live bands and DJs in the garden — the night everyone on the coast turns up to.
activities.description: A beachfront villa just east of Mirissa that anchors the scene: pizza and cold beers at sunset, then live bands and DJs playing deep house and disco. Shima Guni beach club next door keeps going after midnight.

sources.label: Wander with Jo — south-coast nightlife (updated Sep 2026)

activities.goodToKnow: About an hour from Galle. Happy hour 5–6 pm; big special events are ticketed.

activities.title: Candlelit seafood on Mirissa beach
activities.tagline: Pick your fish off the ice, eat with your toes in the sand.
activities.loved: Choosing your own fish off the ice and eating it by the waves is the most-recommended dinner on the coast.
activities.description: Every evening Mirissa's beach restaurants drag tables onto the sand, light candles and lay out the day's catch on ice — tuna, barracuda, prawns, lobster. Pick, they grill, you eat by the waves with a cold Lion.

sources.label: The Land of Wanderlust — Mirissa nightlife & beach bars

familyText.description: Every evening Mirissa's beach restaurants drag tables onto the sand, light candles and lay out the day's catch on ice — tuna, barracuda, prawns, lobster. Pick, they grill, you eat by the waves with a fresh lime juice.

activities.title: Mirissa beach-bar crawl & fire shows
activities.tagline: Sunset cocktails, then the party moves bar to bar.
activities.loved: The party hops between beach bars every night — and the fire dancers after midnight are the bit people film.
activities.description: Mirissa's beach bars light up after dark: sunset cocktails at Zephyr, then wherever the party is that night — themed DJ nights at Papa Mango and Salt, Taboo on Fridays, fire dancers on the sand from around midnight.

sources.label: The Land of Wanderlust — Mirissa nightlife
Wander with Jo — south-coast nightlife (updated Sep 2026)

activities.goodToKnow: Late-night tuk-tuks are scarce — we'd book a driver back to Galle (~1 hr).

activities.title: Weligama surf-bar sundowners
activities.tagline: Watch the last surfers of the day with a cocktail.
activities.loved: The coolest stretch of the coast right now — rooftop bars and surf clubs where a sunset drink turns into a night.
activities.description: Weligama's rooftops and surf clubs look out over the bay's sunset session: The Surfer rooftop, W15's beach club, Ceylon Sliders for burgers and live music. Relaxed but social, and easy to turn into a bigger night.

activities.title: Friday at Tiki Cliff Bar, Weligama
activities.tagline: A cliff-top bar over the ocean with a Friday DJ party.
activities.loved: The busiest night in Weligama — DJs on a cliff over the sea, with a crowd of surfers and travellers.
activities.description: Tiki Cliff Bar sits on the rocks above the ocean outside Weligama. On Fridays it's the town's big night: rotating DJs, cocktails and a dance floor with the sea crashing below.

sources.label: Wander with Jo — south-coast nightlife (updated Sep 2026)

activities.title: Lamana skate party, Ahangama
activities.tagline: DJs, a skate bowl and the whole surf crowd.
activities.loved: Skaters doing tricks while the DJ plays — people say it's the most fun, most Ahangama night of the week.
activities.description: Lamana is a skater-themed venue with a bowl in the middle of the party. On Thursdays (and some Sundays) the DJs play while the local skaters show off, and the surf crowd from Ahangama and Weligama piles in. Best from 9 pm to midnight.

sources.label: Wander with Jo — south-coast nightlife (updated Sep 2026)

activities.goodToKnow: Gets crowded — arrive by 10 pm.

activities.title: Mono: Ahangama's speakeasy
activities.tagline: No sign, a red door, eclectic DJs.
activities.loved: Finding the unmarked red door is half the fun — free entry and the most eclectic DJ sets on the coast.
activities.description: Mono hides behind a red door in a residential block with no signage. Inside: a small, dark speakeasy with themed nights and eclectic DJ sets. Free entry, good cocktails, a local crowd.

sources.label: Wander with Jo — south-coast nightlife (updated Sep 2026)

activities.goodToKnow: Only one detailed recent source lists Mono's nights — we'd confirm on their Instagram in December.

activities.title: Sunday rooftop at Kurundu, Ahangama
activities.tagline: 'After Hours Under the Stars' — Colombo DJs on a rooftop.
activities.loved: Free entry, a rooftop under the stars and Colombo DJs — the Sunday-night ritual of the Ahangama crowd.
activities.description: Every Sunday in season (Nov–Apr), Kurundu's rooftop hosts 'After Hours Under the Stars' with DJs from Colombo, an open-air bar and a dance floor above the palms. Happy hour first, party from about 10:30 pm.

sources.label: Wander with Jo — south-coast nightlife (updated Sep 2026)

activities.title: Rumble in the Jungle, Weligama
activities.tagline: Hard groove, techno and psytrance till late.
activities.loved: For the ones who want to properly dance — the coast's late, loud techno night.
activities.description: Secret Pearl Bar outside Weligama throws 'Rumble in the Jungle' on Saturdays: hard groove, techno and psytrance under the trees until late. Ticketed, with cheaper early-bird releases.

sources.label: Wander with Jo — south-coast nightlife (updated Sep 2026)

activities.goodToKnow: Only one detailed recent source lists this night — we'd confirm it's running in December.

activities.title: Secret Jungle Party, Hiriketiya
activities.tagline: Techno and deep house in a hidden jungle clearing.
activities.loved: The party bus from Hiriketiya into the forest, DJs under the trees — people call it the best night of their trip.
activities.description: On Fridays an underground party pops up in the coastal forest near Hiriketiya: local and international DJs, techno and deep house under the trees, and a cash-only jungle bar. Shuttles run from Hiriketiya every ~30 min.

sources.label: Wander with Jo — south-coast nightlife (updated Sep 2026)

activities.goodToKnow: Fridays only — around New Year the Fridays are 25 Dec and 1 Jan, so we'd check it's running. ~1.5–2 hrs each way from Galle: book a driver to wait. Limited toilets.

activities.title: Sunset at Smoke & Bitters, Hiriketiya
activities.tagline: No. 14 on Asia's 50 Best Bars, in a surf village.
activities.loved: People can't believe one of the world's best bars is a wooden house in Hiriketiya — order whatever's smoked.
activities.description: Smoke & Bitters is No. 14 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2025 and No. 67 in the world — a relaxed open-air bar in the palms above Hiriketiya bay. Smoky, tropical cocktails, great small plates, and Raa (their arrack & toddy bar) next door.

sources.label: Ada Derana — Smoke & Bitters in 2025 rankings

activities.title: NYE rooftop countdown in Colombo
activities.tagline: Champagne above the skyline, fireworks over Galle Face.
activities.loved: A proper dress-up night with the city's fireworks laid out below — glammier and comfier than the beach.
activities.description: Ring in 2027 in the capital: a hotel rooftop or gala dinner with skyline views, then fireworks over Galle Face Green and the Port City at midnight, and a club after if you've got it in you.
activities.goodToKnow: Hotel NYE packages usually go on sale in November; we'd book as a group.

activities.title: NYE by the sea at Mount Lavinia
activities.tagline: Live bands, a beach party and fireworks along the coast.
activities.loved: Dancing on the sand below a 200-year-old mansion, with fireworks all along the Colombo coast.
activities.description: The grand old Mount Lavinia Hotel throws a New Year's Eve party on its beach — 2025's was a Havana-themed night with live Latin bands. Dinner and dancing on the sand, then fireworks along the coast at midnight.
highlights: Beachfront party at a colonial landmark
activities.goodToKnow: A ticketed hotel event — the 2026 party hadn't been announced yet when we checked.

activities.title: NYE beach party on the south coast
activities.tagline: Count down barefoot on Mirissa beach, fireworks overhead.
activities.loved: The biggest night of the year on the coast — the whole bay becomes one party until sunrise.
activities.description: New Year's Eve is the south coast's biggest night, and Mirissa is where everyone goes: beach bars with DJs, fire dancers, fireworks over the water at midnight and dancing until sunrise. The big parties are ticketed and the coast road jams, so we'd head over early with a driver booked back (~1 hr).
activities.goodToKnow: South-coast stays book out early for New Year and prices jump.

activities.title: NYE in Galle Fort
activities.tagline: Dinner in the fort, midnight on the ramparts.
activities.loved: Elegant rather than wild — a long dinner, then the whole fort out on the walls at midnight.
activities.description: A long NYE dinner in one of the fort's colonial hotels or courtyard restaurants, live jazz, then out onto the ramparts at midnight as fireworks pop along the beaches. Unawatuna's parties are 15 minutes away if you want to keep going.

sources.label: Resplendent Ceylon — best restaurants & bars in Galle

activities.goodToKnow: Not one big event — fort restaurants and hotels sell NYE dinners in advance; we'd book in November.

familyText.description: A long NYE dinner in one of the fort's colonial hotels or courtyard restaurants, live jazz, then out onto the ramparts at midnight as fireworks pop along the beaches.

activities.title: Bowling
activities.tagline: Six Brunswick lanes on the seafront.
activities.loved: Sri Lanka's best bowling alley, opened 2025 — a competitive hour before dinner.
activities.description: Playdium on the ground floor of One Galle Face has six Brunswick lanes and a sports bar.

familyText.description: Playdium on the ground floor of One Galle Face has six Brunswick lanes, an arcade next door and a food court upstairs.

activities.title: Arcade, VR & bumper cars
activities.tagline: Arcade machines, a VR zone and bumper cars.
activities.loved: Air hockey and racing games for the inner child.
activities.description: Same venue as the bowling: racing, shooting and basketball games, air hockey, VR and bumper cars.

activities.title: Karaoke room
activities.venue: Playdium karaoke lounge, One Galle Face
activities.tagline: A private room and a very long playlist.
activities.loved: Duets. Mandatory.
activities.description: Book a karaoke room at Playdium's lounge for the crew.

activities.title: Ayurvedic massage
activities.tagline: Warm oils, a proper head massage, total reset.
activities.loved: Pricey for Sri Lanka, but people say the treatments are very good — and it's open till 11 pm.
activities.description: Spa Ceylon is Sri Lanka's best-known Ayurvedic spa brand; the Colombo Fort branch is in a restored colonial building, open 10 am–11 pm.

sources.label: i-Discover Asia — Spa Ceylon Colombo Fort

activities.title: Late-night kottu at Pilawoos
activities.venue: Hotel de Pilawoos, Galle Road, Kollupitiya
activities.tagline: The cheese kottu every Colombo night ends with.
activities.loved: A 24-hour drive-in institution — they bring the kottu to your car.
activities.description: Pilawoos on Galle Road is open 24 hours: the clang of kottu blades, cheese kottu and iced Milo after a night out.
activities.goodToKnow: Lots of places use the name — the Galle Road (Kollupitiya) one is the original.

activities.title: Kalutara's hollow stupa
activities.tagline: Walk inside a giant white stupa by the river.
activities.loved: The one stupa in Sri Lanka you can walk inside — every driver on the Galle Road stops here.
activities.description: Right on the Galle Road by the Kalu Ganga bridge: a huge hollow stupa painted inside with Jataka tales, and a sacred Bodhi tree across the road.

activities.title: Snorkelling
activities.tagline: Reef fish and the odd turtle, straight off the sand.
activities.loved: Calm, clear water a few strokes from the beach.
activities.description: Rent a mask and fins on Unawatuna beach and snorkel the reef, or take a short boat to Jungle Beach's sheltered cove.

activities.title: Sunset catamaran
activities.tagline: Three hours of sails, snacks and a pink sky.
activities.loved: Paddleboards off the back and a sunset at sea — or charter the whole boat as a group.
activities.description: Shared catamaran cruises leave Mirissa harbour at 3 pm and return at 6 pm (Oct–Apr), with a welcome drink, snacks, swimming and SUP.
activities.goodToKnow: ~US$65 pp on shared trips (min. 4 adults), or ~US$900 to charter the boat for up to 30.

activities.title: Ayurvedic massage
activities.tagline: An hour of warm oils after a day in the sun.
activities.loved: Simple beach-side Ayurveda huts are cheap and lovely; the fort spas are a treat.
activities.description: From beach-side Ayurveda huts in Unawatuna to the spas in Galle Fort — 60–90 minutes of oil massage.

sources.label: Red Dot Tours — spa & Ayurveda on the Galle coast

activities.title: Sea turtle hatchery
activities.tagline: Baby turtles, rescued adults and a sunset release.
activities.loved: Guides who explain every clutch — and, if you time it right, an evening release.
activities.description: Community hatcheries near Koggala buy eggs from fishermen and release the babies; arrive ~6 pm for the evening release.

sources.label: For 91 Days — the Habaraduwa turtle hatchery

activities.goodToKnow: Quality varies between hatcheries here — we'd go to one with good recent reviews.

activities.title: Stilt fishermen photo stop
activities.tagline: The postcard shot, 25 minutes from Galle.
activities.loved: Golden hour silhouettes over the surf.
activities.description: The famous stilt fishermen perched over the surf at Koggala — best at golden hour. Expect to tip for photos.

activities.title: Peace Pagoda sunset
activities.tagline: A white stupa on a jungle headland at golden hour.
activities.loved: Lonely Planet calls the sunset views 'spellbinding' — and it's free.
activities.description: The Japanese Peace Pagoda sits on the Rumassala headland with views back over Galle Fort. Tuk-tuk up, watch the sun go down.

activities.title: Thalpe rock pools
activities.tagline: Swim in pools carved into the reef 50 years ago.
activities.loved: A natural infinity pool at low tide — and almost nobody there.
activities.description: Square pools cut into the coral reef at Thalpe (once used to soak coconut husks) make calm natural swimming pools at low tide.

activities.title: Morning yoga class
activities.tagline: Vinyasa in a jungle shala, then the pool.
activities.loved: Mats, bolsters, pool and showers included — about US$10.
activities.description: Drop-in vinyasa at 8:30 am daily at The Nuga House in Ahangama; there are plenty of other shalas along the coast.

sources.label: Girl on a Zebra — yoga in Ahangama (2025)

activities.title: Guided Galle Fort walk
activities.tagline: Two hours of stories behind the ramparts.
activities.loved: Rated 4.9–5★ by hundreds — the guides make the fort come alive.
activities.description: A local guide walks you through the fort's churches, mansions and bastions with 400 years of stories. Evening starts beat the heat.

activities.title: Nine Arches Bridge
activities.tagline: The 1921 stone viaduct in the jungle — time it for a train.
activities.loved: Everyone waits for the blue train curving across the arches; the 6:30am crossing is quiet, the mid-morning ones draw crowds.
activities.description: A colonial-era railway viaduct between Ella and Demodara, a 30–45 min walk from town through tea (or a short tuk-tuk). Trains cross roughly at ~6:30am, ~9:15am, ~10:45am, ~11:50am, ~1:30pm, ~3:20pm and ~5:30pm — they often run late, so check in town and wait a little.

sources.label: Visit Ella — Nine Arch Bridge and the Ella–Demodara timetable
Sri Lanka Spirit — Nine Arch Bridge: when to visit (2026)
Hungarian Dreamers — how to visit Nine Arch Bridge

activities.title: 98 Acres viewpoint & café
activities.tagline: Coffee on a tea-estate deck facing Little Adam's Peak.
activities.loved: The open-air deck looks straight across the tea to the peak — the classic breakfast stop after the sunrise walk.
activities.description: A resort on a 98-acre tea estate at the foot of Little Adam's Peak, about 15 minutes' walk from the trail. Its open-air restaurant deck looks across the hills to the peak — good for breakfast or a long lunch.
highlights: Deck view of Little Adam's Peak

activities.title: Flying Ravana zipline
activities.tagline: One of Sri Lanka's longest ziplines — over the tea at ~80 km/h.
activities.loved: A proper rush over the valley; people say it's short but worth it for the view.
activities.description: From the hillside near Little Adam's Peak the line flies you across the valley over tea fields at up to ~80 km/h (published lengths vary, ~550 m to ~1 km). Open about 9am–5pm — book ahead in busy weeks.

sources.label: Lakpura — Mega Zip Line in Ella (from $32)
Life.lk — Flying through Ella: Flying Ravana

activities.title: Ravana Falls
activities.tagline: A wide, tumbling waterfall right by the road home.
activities.loved: An easy roadside stop — some people swim in the pool at the base when the flow is gentle.
activities.description: About 6 km south of Ella on the A23 — the road back toward Galle — so it's an easy stop on the way home. Free to visit; in the dry season the pool at the base is calmer.

sources.label: Jonny Melon — Ravana Falls complete guide (2025)

activities.title: Colombo night food & dessert crawl
activities.tagline: Kottu, isso vadai, falooda — and room for wattalappam.
activities.loved: Colombo's best food comes out after dark — the clang of kottu blades is the city's soundtrack.
activities.description: A tuk-tuk crawl through Colombo after dark: isso vadai on Galle Face Green, cheese kottu at a 24-hour kottu shop on Galle Road, then falooda and wattalappam for dessert. Loud, cheap and very local.

activities.title: Lotus Tower after dark & Galle Face
activities.tagline: The whole city lit up below you.
activities.loved: The night view from the deck — and the tower's own light show from Galle Face afterwards.
activities.description: Ride up the Lotus Tower at night for the lights of Colombo and the port, then stroll Galle Face Green as the tower changes colour, with a king coconut and something sweet from the stalls.

activities.title: Bowling & arcade night at Playdium
activities.tagline: Six lanes, an arcade and a very competitive crew.
activities.loved: Sri Lanka's best bowling alley — people lose hours on the lanes and the air hockey.
activities.description: Playdium at One Galle Face: bowling on six Brunswick lanes, the arcade, VR and bumper cars, then dinner at the food court upstairs. Proper group fun, start to finish.

activities.title: NYE fireworks on Galle Face Green
activities.tagline: The whole city counting down by the sea.
activities.loved: Families, kites and food stalls — Colombo's biggest free celebration, with fireworks over the ocean.
activities.description: Join the crowds on Galle Face Green for New Year's Eve: dinner from the food stalls, a walk along the promenade, then fireworks over the sea and the Port City at midnight.

activities.title: Galle Fort by lamplight: gelato & the lighthouse
activities.tagline: Quiet lantern-lit lanes, gelato and the sea wall at night.
activities.loved: The fort is at its prettiest after dark, when the day-trippers have gone home.
activities.description: Wander Galle Fort's lantern-lit lanes after dinner: gelato on Pedlar Street, a wood-apple juice, the lighthouse glowing over the ramparts and the sound of the sea against the walls.

sources.label: Insight Guides — a walk around Galle Fort

activities.title: Galle night market & dessert crawl
activities.tagline: Hoppers, kottu and faluda — nine holes, no par.
activities.loved: A crawl with a scorecard, and you end the night full of hoppers.
activities.description: A food crawl in and around the fort: egg hoppers fresh off the pan, kottu from a roadside stall, short eats from a bakery, then faluda and watalappam to finish. Score each stop out of ten.

sources.label: Life.lk — insider's foodie guide to Galle Fort

activities.title: Sunset & seafood on Hikkaduwa beach
activities.tagline: Toes in the sand, grilled catch of the day.
activities.loved: Hikkaduwa's long beach at sunset, with turtles still bobbing in the shallows.
activities.description: Watch the sun go down over Hikkaduwa's long beach, then pick a fish off the ice at a beachside restaurant and eat by the waves.

activities.title: Coconut Tree Hill sunset & beach dinner
activities.tagline: Golden hour on the palm hill, then dinner by candlelight.
activities.loved: Coconut Tree Hill at sunset is the photo everyone wants — then a slow dinner on the sand.
activities.description: Catch the sunset from Mirissa's Coconut Tree Hill, then walk down to the beach for a candlelit dinner — grilled fish, devilled prawns and fresh lime juice.

activities.title: Weligama sunset session & café dinner
activities.tagline: King coconuts, the last surfers and smoothie bowls for dinner.
activities.loved: Watching the sunset surf session from the sand is Weligama's best free show.
activities.description: Grab a king coconut and watch the last surfers of the day ride Weligama Bay at sunset, then head to one of the town's surf cafés for burgers, rice and curry or a late smoothie bowl.

activities.title: Ahangama sunset & café dinner
activities.tagline: The coast's coolest little food scene, at sunset.
activities.loved: Ahangama's cafés are why people stay longer than planned.
activities.description: Sunset on the beach at Kabalana, then dinner on Ahangama's strip of creative cafés — poke bowls, wood-fired flatbreads, Sri Lankan curries and good coffee for the road.

activities.title: Hiriketiya bay sunset & dinner
activities.tagline: A horseshoe bay turning pink, then dinner in the palms.
activities.loved: The tiny bay at golden hour is one of the most beautiful spots on the coast.
activities.description: Sit on the sand as the sun drops behind Hiriketiya's horseshoe bay, then dinner at one of the palm-shaded cafés above the beach before the drive back.

activities.title: NYE seafood on the sand & fireworks over the bay
activities.tagline: A long beach dinner, then midnight fireworks over Mirissa.
activities.loved: You get the fireworks and the beach without the 4 am crowd.
activities.description: Book an early table on Mirissa beach for a seafood dinner, walk the sand as the bay fills up, watch the fireworks over the water at midnight and head home soon after.

sources.label: friday.lk — New Year's Eve events island-wide 2026
